about.title: About ChisinauDex
about.lead: ChisinauDex is Chișinău City Hall's document assistant. It does not write answers from memory: it searches public documents, extracts the relevant passages, and quotes them exactly.
how: A crawler reads the 41 official websites on City Hall's list daily: news, pages, PDF regulations.
Each page receives a score for authority, date, and integrity. Spam or compromised pages are put in quarantine.

Every chunk has a vector (multilingual model). The question is searched by meaning in pgvector and by keywords; the 5 most relevant chunks go to the model. A question in Russian also finds Romanian documents.
The AI model is only allowed to select and link citations. Every sentence must have an exact citation.
Every citation is checked against the source text. Sentences without a verified citation are removed.
If the AI is unavailable, ChisinauDex extracts the relevant sentences directly and searches live on the official websites.
about.sourcesSub: Status as of the latest automatic check.
about.roles: Residents ask questions, get information for their address and send petitions. Municipal employees also see content management: contradictions between documents, unanswered questions, broken pages and residents' petitions.
about.a11y: The platform follows WCAG 2.2 level AA: full keyboard navigation, visible focus, sufficient contrast, resizable text up to 150%, modes for color blindness and low vision, text-to-speech for answers. Open the "Accessibility" menu in the header.
about.lang: The interface and answers are available in Romanian, Russian and English. Quotes stay in the document's original language; in AI mode a translation is shown alongside.

privacy.title: Privacy and cookie policy
sections: What data we process
The questions you ask, the answer status, and ratings (stars, tags, comment). We do not ask for a name, email, or account.
Your address
The address you enter stays in this browser. To find the sector and coordinates, we send it to the OpenStreetMap Nominatim service; live data comes from Apă-Canal Chișinău and the Urban Bus Park.
Location

We ask once whether to fill in your address from your location; only if you answer "Yes" (or press "Use my location") does your browser ask for permission. If you have already allowed location for this site, the field fills in automatically when the page opens. The coordinates are sent once to the ChisinauDex server and to OpenStreetMap Nominatim to find the street; they are not saved and do not appear in server logs. The address stays in your browser and is kept on the device only if you tick "Remember the address". Legal basis: your explicit consent (GDPR Art. 6(1)(a)); you can withdraw it in your browser settings.
Artificial intelligence

When AI mode is on, the question and the passages found are sent to the model provider (xAI Grok or Groq) to compose the answer. No identifying data is sent. Without an AI key everything runs on the ChisinauDex server.
Cookies and local storage

Necessary: language, profile, and accessibility preferences, and cookie consent, in the browser's local storage. Analytics (only with consent): a random session identifier and the page visited, stored on ChisinauDex's server. We do not use third-party cookies for advertising or tracking.
Fonts
Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts, which receives the browser's IP address.
Your rights
You can withdraw your consent for analytics at any time from "Cookie settings" in the page footer, and you can delete local data from your browser settings.

statement.title: Accessibility statement
statement.intro: Chișinău City Hall is committed to making the ChisinauDex service accessible to everyone, in line with the European standard EN 301 549 and WCAG 2.2 level AA.
sections: Compliance status
ChisinauDex is partially compliant with WCAG 2.2 level AA, due to the exceptions listed below.
Content that is not fully accessible

The original documents on institutions' sites (especially scanned PDFs) may not be accessible; ChisinauDex shows their extracted text where it exists.
Quotes stay in the document's original language (usually Romanian).
Artificial intelligence
Answers may be composed automatically by an artificial intelligence system that may only select and connect exact quotes from the official documents. Answers are not legal advice.
Preparation of this statement

This statement was prepared on 26.09.2026. Measures in place: full keyboard navigation, visible focus, a contrast-checked palette, status messages for screen readers, text resizing up to 150%, colour-blind and low-vision modes. A formal audit (automated testing and screen-reader testing) is planned.
Feedback and contact
If you have difficulties using the service, use the form below or City Hall's One-Stop Shop (bd. Ștefan cel Mare și Sfânt 83, Chișinău). We reply within 30 days.
Enforcement procedure
If our reply does not satisfy you, you can file a petition under the Administrative Code.
